title: The Acute Effect of Exercise on Appetite Appetite-regulating Hormones and Inflammation in Children
brief_summary: This study describes the effect of acute high intensity exercise at 70% VO2peak on inflammation, stress, appetite hormones and appetite in lean and obese children and adolescents.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 11 normal weight and 11 obese boys will be recruited for the study. Lean and obese boys aged 10-18 years, born full-term and with a normal body weight at birth, will be included in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dieters and individuals with lactose intolerance, allergies to milk and dairy products and gastrointestinal problems will be excluded from the study.
